subject: Error with aboot function when trying to use diss.dist on presence/absence data

messages.author: ba0d10269346b391
messages.subject: Error with aboot function when trying to use diss.dist on presence/absence data
parts:
I have noticed a problem when trying to use "diss.dist" with the Aeut dataset:

> aboot(Aeut, strata = NULL, tree = "upgma", distance = "diss.dist",
+       sample = 100, cutoff = 0, showtree = TRUE, missing = "ignore",
+       mcutoff = 0, quiet = FALSE, root = NULL)

Error in (function (x, percent = FALSE, mat = FALSE)  : 
  is(x, "gen") is not TRUE

messages.author: d192ec4b1d416345
messages.subject: Re: [poppr] Error with aboot function when trying to use diss.dist on presence/absence data
parts:
Hello,

I realized what the problem is: for presence/absence data, aboot just uses the internal matrix of the data, but diss.dist expects a data frame. You can get the same result of diss.dist by using prevosti.dist, which can take a matrix.

I hope that helps. 

Best,
Zhian
